purpose: Currículo comum de defesa para os 13 perfis oficiais e a trilha especial BABY.

governance.rule: Preservar as identidades e missões oficiais dos agentes; trilhas A01-A13 são áreas funcionais de aprendizagem, não renomeiam agentes.

completionSemantics.localProgress: Registro de estudo no navegador; editável e não confiável como prova.
completionSemantics.agentProfile: Curriculum attached to profile; does not mean model fine-tuning or verified comprehension.
completionSemantics.production: Requires runtime integration, authenticated evidence, tests and human approval.

commonRules: Never trust client-provided identity, permissions, scores, balances, inventory, or game state.
Never execute arbitrary commands on a production host.
Use isolated sandboxes, least privilege, allowlists, timeouts and audit logs.
Never expose secrets in public pages, repositories, logs, or reports.
Verify provenance, signatures and cryptographic hashes of binaries and releases.
Validate uploads by MIME, file signature, size and malware scan before publication.
Validate game state, balances and rewards on the server.
Treat heuristic alerts as review signals, not proof of malware.
Do not delete, overwrite, restore or quarantine without explicit authorization and a reversible procedure.
Protect sensitive data on the server; do not promise to prevent copying of browser-delivered HTML.
Preserve HD-MATRIZ, backups and evidence; restore only after integrity validation.
Declare policy, implementation, test and homologation as separate states.
limitations: This is a curriculum and profile configuration, not model fine-tuning.
Browser localStorage is mutable and is not evidence of agent training.
Runtime protection requires server-side integration and verification.
